global_attributes.title: Tropical Cyclone Precipitation, Infrared, Microwave, and Environmental Dataset (TC PRIMED)
global_attributes.summary: The Tropical Cyclone Precipitation, Infrared, Microwave, and Environmental Dataset (TC PRIMED) is a dataset of satellite passive microwave observations of global tropical cyclones from the NASA GPM Constellation. The TC PRIMED overpass file contains storm metadata interpolated to overpass time, inter-calibrated passive microwave brightness temperatures, NASA GPROF precipitation retrievals, nearly-coincident infrared brightness temperatures from a geostationary satellite (when available), and precipitation variables from the combined radar-radiometer product for the TRMM or GPM satellites (when available). The TC PRIMED environmental file contains storm metadata, environmental diagnostics derived from the ECMWF reanalysis, and gridded rectilinear and re-gridded cylindrical fields from the ECMWF reanalysis at each synoptic time throughout the storm's life. Also included in the environmental file is a list of all overpasses associated with a particular storm.
global_attributes.comment: TC PRIMED uses hierarchical groups within its netCDF datasets, which may not be initially visible from some software.

 Razin, M. N., C. J. Slocum, J. A. Knaff, P. J. Brown, and M. M. Bell, 2023: Tropical Cyclone Precipitation, Infrared, Microwave, and Environmental Dataset (TC PRIMED). Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc., 104, E1980–E1998, https://doi.org/10.1175/BAMS-D-21-0052.1.
